sources.name: Catalogue of Life
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 unless a constituent dataset specifies otherwise
sources.notes: Pin a ChecklistBank dataset key and release DOI before ingestion. Never ingest the moving latest archive directly into a published release.

sources.name: World Checklist of Vascular Plants
sources.licence: Use the licence and citation included with the pinned WCVP release
sources.notes: Primary vascular-plant taxonomic overlay. Preserve source treatment when it differs from other backbones.

sources.name: Plants of the World Online
sources.scope: plant profiles, distribution and media links
sources.licence: Source-specific; cite POWO and underlying datasets
sources.notes: Use for reviewed profile evidence and links, not as an unversioned bulk overwrite. Manual review only because the public site is protected by bot-challenge controls and does not provide a CI-safe release signal.

sources.name: International Plant Names Index
sources.licence: Confirm current IPNI terms for each integration
sources.notes: Nomenclatural authority. A published name is not automatically the accepted taxonomic concept.

sources.name: Australian Plant Name Index and Australian Plant Census
sources.scope: Australian nomenclature and accepted regional taxonomy
sources.licence: Confirm National Species List terms and attribution for each export
sources.notes: APNI records names and usage; APC supplies nationally accepted Australian concepts. Keep those roles distinct. Manual review only because the public NSL services endpoint is protected by WAF challenge controls and does not provide a CI-safe release signal.
